review_description: Very thorough sales presentation. Gave options for finance or cash price. Installers arrived on time and were finished in four hours. Clean and tidy.

I don't normally like door to door salesmen, but I was really impressed with this one. I already had a solar system and he explained how much I could save by adding an extra 3.3 kwh.  The installation occurred 10 days after signing the paperwork and I could not be more impressed at how efficient they put these panels up plus the inverter. I am very happy with the Grand Group especially how helpful and happy they always are, nothing is too much trouble.I would definitely recommend this group if you are thinking about installing solar panels.Thank youGary Smith
